title: Plan: Precession, Nutation, Obliquity, Delta-T, Sidereal Time
description:
Port the remainder of swephlib.c (~3100 lines) plus swenut2000a.h nutation series data (~2819 lines). This is the first module that uses the context struct for caching.

## Functions to port

### Obliquity (swephlib.c:887)
- `swi_epsiln(tjd, iflag, serr)` → method on context; caches `oec` and `oec2000`
- 4 models: IAU 1976, IAU 2006, Laskar 1986, Vondrák 2011
- Returns ε in radians with precomputed sin(ε), cos(ε)
- Struct: `Epsilon { tjd: f64, eps: f64, sin_eps: f64, cos_eps: f64 }`

### Precession (swephlib.c:1373)
- `swi_precess(x, tjd, iflag, direction)` — router function selecting algorithm by model + time range
- 3 algorithm families:
  - `precess_1()` — Euler angle method (IAU 1976/2000/2006, Bretagnon 2003, Newcomb). Computes Z, z, Θ as polynomials in T, applies R_z(Z) × R_y(-Θ) × R_z(z)
  - `precess_2()` — ecliptic-based long-term (Laskar 1986, Williams 1994, Simon 1994). 11-term polynomials up to T^10 for ecliptic precession
  - `precess_3()` — Vondrák 2011 (default). Equator+ecliptic pole positions from polynomials + 14/10 periodic terms, matrix from cross product
- 11 models total: SEMOD_PREC_IAU_1976 through SEMOD_PREC_NEWCOMB

### Nutation (swephlib.c:2126)
- `swi_nutation(tjd, iflag, nutlo)` — main entry, with optional 3-point quadratic interpolation cache
- `calc_nutation_iau1980()` — 105 terms using 5 Delaunay arguments. Pre-computes sin/cos for multiples.
- `calc_nutation_iau2000ab()` — 678+687 terms (2000A) or 488 terms (2000B). Two stages: luni-solar + planetary. Series data from swenut2000a.h.
- 5 models: IAU 1980, +Herring 1987, IAU 2000A, IAU 2000B (default), Woolard
- JPL Horizons mode: IAU 1980 base + Bessel interpolation of IERS EOP data
- Nutation struct: `Nutation { tjd: f64, nutlo: [f64;2], sin_nut: f64, cos_nut: f64, matrix: [[f64;3];3] }`
- Interpolation cache: `NutationInterpolation { tjd0: f64, tjd2: f64, dpsi: [f64;3], deps: [f64;3] }`

### Frame bias (swephlib.c:2205)
- `swi_bias(x, tjd, iflag, backward)` — applies GCRS↔J2000 rotation matrix
- 3 models: none, IAU 2000, IAU 2006 (default)
- Fixed 3×3 matrix multiply

### Delta-T (swephlib.c:2772)
- `swe_deltat_ex(tjd, iflag, serr)` — TT−UT in days
- Dispatcher by year range: long-term parabola → model-specific → tabulated (1620–present) → extrapolation
- 5 pre-1620 models: Stephenson-Morrison 1984/2004, Stephenson 1997, Espenak-Meeus 2006, Stephenson 2016 (default)
- 1620–present: tabulated values with 4th-order Bessel interpolation (catalogue-internal §7.2)
- Tidal acceleration adjustment: correction = -0.000091 × (tid_acc - tid_acc_ref) × (Year-1955)²
- Needs: tabulated Delta-T array (yearly values), leap second table

### Sidereal time (swephlib.c:3464)
- `swe_sidtime0(tjd_ut, eps, nut)` — GAST in hours
- `swe_sidtime(tjd_ut)` — auto-computes obliquity/nutation
- 4 models: IAU 1976, IAU 2006, IERS 2010, long-term (default)
- Equation of equinoxes: 33-term Fourier expansion

## Context struct impact
This is where caching starts. The context needs:
- `oec: Option<Epsilon>` — obliquity at date (cache key: tjd)
- `oec2000: Option<Epsilon>` — obliquity at J2000 (computed once)
- `nut: Option<Nutation>` — nutation at date
- `nut2000: Option<Nutation>` — nutation at J2000
- `interpol: NutationInterpolation` — 3-point interpolation cache
- `astro_models: [i32; 8]` — selected models
- `tid_acc: f64` — tidal acceleration

**Split borrow consideration:** Functions computing apparent positions need to read obliquity while writing nutation (or vice versa). Design the cache so `oec` and `nut` can be borrowed independently — either as separate fields on the top-level struct, or by computing into locals before storing.

## Data tables
- swenut2000a.h — 1325 nutation terms as static arrays. Port as `const` arrays in a `nutation_data` module.
- Delta-T tabulated values — yearly array embedded in swephlib.c
- Sidereal time equation of equinoxes — 33 coefficients

## Testing
- setest/suite_05_date_time.c covers Delta-T
- setest/suite_03_misc.c likely covers sidereal time
- Golden data: compute obliquity/nutation/delta-T/sidereal-time at known epochs (J2000, B1950, historical dates) with each model, compare to C
- Nutation interpolation: verify the 3-point cache produces results within stated 3 milliarcsecond error

## C source reference
- swephlib.c:887 — swi_epsiln
- swephlib.c:1373 — swi_precess (router + 3 algorithm families)
- swephlib.c:2126 — swi_nutation + calc_nutation_iau1980 + calc_nutation_iau2000ab
- swephlib.c:2205 — swi_bias
- swephlib.c:2772 — swe_deltat_ex + tabulated data + Bessel interpolation
- swephlib.c:3464 — swe_sidtime0
- swenut2000a.h:1-2819 — IAU 2000A nutation series data

## Dependencies
- Phase 0 (types, constants, context struct)
- Phase 2 (polynomial evaluation via swi_nterm_pol, angle normalization)
execution_record: Decomposed into 6 session-sized implementation tasks (swisseph-rs/18-23). Key correction from original description: removed all caching/context-mutation assumptions — the architecture is stateless (Ephemeris holds read-only config, all methods take &self, pipeline is pure). Caching is a dispatcher concern (swisseph-rs/6), not this layer.
